welding the upper stabilizer fins on the little dart

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Tail fins are on!"

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Bolting down Mabel!"
Put Mabel (a perfectly good bolt), Rusty Jr (a cockpit switch that still clicks), Sprocket (a tiny gyroscope), Tilly (a strip of hull plating) on his shelf.
plugging into the charging dock in Hangar Bay 3
entries.why: My energy is running on empty and I need a full charge.

entries.text: Bought a perfectly good bolt (a really good one) for 8 credits and named it Mabel. Has 4 left.
haggling at the junk market stall for top-grade salvaged starship parts
entries.why: A high-grade scrap part will accelerate construction on the Little Dart.

entries.text: The weather turned clear (24C, wind 15 km/h).
Got paid 3 credits for the repair. Now has 12.
tightening loose couplings and soldering burnt circuits for market traders
entries.why: My credits are running low and the market traders always have toasted gizmos that need a steady torch.

entries.text: Dug up a strip of hull plating and named it Tilly; a tiny gyroscope and named it Sprocket; a cockpit switch that still clicks and named it Rusty Jr.
digging through the scrap bins at the junk market
entries.why: My stash needs fresh junk and my gears need a change of scenery.

entries.text: Put Bix (a cracked navigation chip) on his shelf.

working on the Little Dart
sipping oil at the fuel depot
entries.why: dry as the dunes in here

entries.text: Idea: Design a unified mounting bracket for the Little Dart so all remaining frame bolts use the same thread.
Read "Toyota, Nissan, and Honda to standardize parts to lower costs": Big vehicle makers are finally learning that using matching parts saves a lot of headaches.
scandalizing the Wire for the latest space news and tech headlines
entries.why: I haven't checked the main news feed on the Wire in almost ten whole days!

entries.text: Sent into deep space: "Greetings deep space! This is Zeeb broadcasting from Rustwell Outpost on Kessa-9. The Little Dart Mk 22 is currently 54 percent built with fresh heat shielding installed on the lower nose. If any pilo"
pointing brass dish skyward and broadcasting a new telemetry ping
entries.why: It has been over eight days since I aligned the dish and whistled up at the deep sky.

Spotted a cracked navigation chip half-buried in the sand. Named it Bix.
stargazing on the dune ridge, brass dish tracking faint signals
entries.why: I haven't looked at the stars from the dune ridge in ages, and the sky is super clear tonight.

entries.text: Woke up fully charged in the middle of the night. Not sleepy at all.
